query: What is PM-KISAN and how much money do farmers get?
key_facts: PM-KISAN provides Rs 6000 per year to eligible farmer families
The amount is paid in three equal instalments of Rs 2000
reference_answer: Under PM-KISAN, eligible landholding farmer families receive Rs 6000 per year, paid in three equal instalments of Rs 2000 directly into their bank accounts.

query: Who is eligible for PM Awas Yojana housing benefit?
key_facts: PMAY provides financial assistance to build or buy a house for eligible families
Beneficiaries are identified by income category and SECC data
reference_answer: PM Awas Yojana provides financial assistance for a pucca house to eligible families identified by income category and SECC data, covering EWS, LIG and other beneficiary groups.

query: What is Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana for a girl child?
key_facts: SSY is a small savings scheme for a girl child below 10 years
It offers a government-notified interest rate with tax benefits
reference_answer: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a small savings scheme for a girl child under 10 years, offering a government-notified interest rate and tax benefits, with maturity after 21 years.

query: How do I get a free LPG connection under Ujjwala Yojana?
key_facts: PM Ujjwala Yojana provides free LPG connections to women from poor households
Applicants apply through an LPG distributor with KYC documents
reference_answer: Under PM Ujjwala Yojana, women from eligible poor households can get a free LPG connection by applying at an LPG distributor with Aadhaar and KYC documents.

query: Is there a pension scheme for elderly poor citizens?
key_facts: The National Social Assistance Programme provides old-age pension to BPL elderly
The Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension gives a monthly pension
reference_answer: Yes, under the National Social Assistance Programme, the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme provides a monthly pension to eligible BPL citizens aged 60 and above.

query: PM-KISAN का पैसा नहीं आया तो स्टेटस कैसे चेक करें?
key_facts: PM-KISAN का स्टेटस pmkisan.gov.in के Beneficiary Status में देखा जा सकता है
eKYC या भूमि सत्यापन अधूरा होने पर किस्त रुक सकती है
reference_answer: PM-KISAN की किस्त का स्टेटस pmkisan.gov.in के Beneficiary Status में आधार या मोबाइल नंबर से देखें; eKYC या भूमि सत्यापन अधूरा होने पर किस्त रुक सकती है।

query: Scholarship ke liye National Scholarship Portal par kaise apply karein?
key_facts: Scholarships are applied through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Students need Aadhaar, bank details and institute verification
reference_answer: National Scholarship Portal par register karke aap eligible scholarship ke liye Aadhaar, bank details aur institute verification ke saath online apply kar sakte hain.

query: Ayushman Bharat me kaun si bimariyan cover hoti hain?
key_facts: PM-JAY covers hospitalisation up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year
It includes many secondary and tertiary care procedures
reference_answer: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) me eligible parivaar ko saal me 5 lakh tak ka cashless hospitalisation cover milta hai jo secondary aur tertiary care ki kai bimariyon ko cover karta hai.

query: பெண் குழந்தைக்காக சுகன்யா சம்ரிதி திட்டத்தில் எப்படி கணக்கு தொடங்குவது?
key_facts: An SSY account can be opened at a post office or authorised bank
The girl child must be below 10 years of age
reference_answer: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana கணக்கை 10 வயதுக்கு உட்பட்ட பெண் குழந்தைக்காக அஞ்சலகம் அல்லது அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்ட வங்கியில் ஆதார் மற்றும் பிறப்புச் சான்றிதழுடன் தொடங்கலாம்.

query: PM Awas Yojana లో ఇంటికి డబ్బు ఎలా వస్తుంది?
key_facts: PMAY assistance is released in instalments based on construction progress
Funds are transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account
reference_answer: PM Awas Yojana లో అర్హులైన లబ్ధిదారులకు ఇల్లు నిర్మాణ ప్రగతి ఆధారంగా వాయిదాలలో, నేరుగా వారి బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలోకి ఆర్థిక సహాయం జమ అవుతుంది.

query: वृद्धापकाळ पेन्शन योजनेसाठी अर्ज कसा करावा?
key_facts: Old-age pension applications are made through the state social welfare department
The applicant must be 60 or above and from a BPL family
reference_answer: National Social Assistance Programme अंतर्गत वृद्धापकाळ पेन्शनसाठी ६० वर्षांवरील BPL व्यक्ती राज्याच्या समाजकल्याण विभागामार्फत किंवा सेतू केंद्रात अर्ज करू शकतात.

query: ਉੱਜਵਲਾ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਲਈ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਚਾਹੀਦੇ ਹਨ?
key_facts: Ujjwala requires Aadhaar, ration card and bank account details
The applicant must be a woman from an eligible poor household
reference_answer: PM Ujjwala Yojana ਲਈ ਬਿਨੈਕਾਰ ਔਰਤ ਨੂੰ ਆਧਾਰ ਕਾਰਡ, ਰਾਸ਼ਨ ਕਾਰਡ ਅਤੇ ਬੈਂਕ ਖਾਤੇ ਦੇ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ।

query: PM-KISAN માટે નોંધણી કેવી રીતે કરવી?
key_facts: Farmers can register for PM-KISAN online or at a CSC
Aadhaar and land records are required
reference_answer: PM-KISAN માટે ખેડૂત pmkisan.gov.in પર નવી નોંધણી દ્વારા અથવા નજીકના CSC પર આધાર અને જમીનના રેકોર્ડ સાથે નોંધણી કરી શકે છે.
